known_results: All v1 and v2 stock-versus-market outcomes are known, including v2 primary additions2.314846pp and2021–25 1.311479pp. The historical full-window matched-control results were already known. No new AD+1 matched-control horizon computed yet.
reason: Diagnose whether the post-public-announcement stock-versus-index comparison also differs from already frozen similar-stock controls. No matching model or control identities will be re-estimated.
rule: Intersect v2 status ok at delay1 with existing event_paths exactly by event_id and require all3 fixed c1_ric/c2_ric/c3_ric stocks have strictly observed total returns and positive endpoint prices for the unchanged AD+1close to ED-1close. Equal initial notional in each of3 controls, buy-and-hold. No cancellation controls exist; do not invent them. No replacement controls or fill when any is missing.
metric: For additions stock terminal factor minus average3control terminal factors; for deletions reverse sign. Report stock-versus-OMXSBGI on exact same rows beside this metric. Same review means,tCI,signflip asv2. No causal interpretation.
periods: All2017–2025 and already specified2021–2025 descriptive sensitivity, both addition/deletion; no further horizon/subgroup search.
limitations: Existing matching uses preannouncement characteristics but its historical panel construction/coverage is inherited. The diagnostic subset is not the complete investable announcement universe. This is conditional evidence, not proof against unobserved selection or attention.
no_additional_strategy: Controls are a scientific comparison only, not an assumed practical funding instrument or advice to short them.
